- Rule 1: If someone is kind then they are round. → Dave is round.
- Rule 6: Round people are cold. → Dave is cold.

3. If someone is nice and not young then they are not blue. (i.e., nice ∧ ¬young => ¬blue)
4. If Fiona is kind then Fiona is blue.
5. If Dave is kind and Dave is blue then Dave is not nice.
6. Round people are cold. (i.e., round => cold)

8. If Erin is kind and Erin is blue then Erin is round.

Now we have Dave is kind. Also we know Dave is quiet (but not needed). We have Dave is kind.

Now rule 1: If someone is kind then they are round. So Dave is round.

Now rule 6: Round people are cold. So Dave is cold.

Thus we derived Dave is cold. So answer True.
